description: Tuning set v2, authored 2026-10-08 for the twin-document and similar-program citation work. Not part of the locked 120-question baseline: tune against these, confirm on questions.json. No question here shares a gold document and expected section with a locked question (a test enforces it). Twin questions (tu01-tu08) ask a fact that a process, handbook or neighbor document restates while pointing at the policy that owns it; the owner is the gold. Similar-program questions (tu09-tu16) sit next to a similarly named program or policy the corpus calls different. v1 of this file overlapped the locked set and is kept as evals/results/2026-10-08-quality/superseded-tuning-questions-v1.json; tu02, tu03, tu09 and tu10 carry over from it (v1 tq04, tq12, tq05, tq15).

questions.query: For how many days after closure can a customer reopen a support ticket?
questions.note: Twin: the Agent Performance Scorecard counts reopens 'within 7 days of closure per the Ticket Handling and Priority Policy'; the ticket policy owns the 7-day rule.

questions.query: Once a refund is approved, how long until the money reaches the customer?
questions.note: Twin (v1 tq04): the Customer Complaint Escalation Path restates 5 to 10 business days as 'the Refund Policy's payment processing'.

questions.query: A support manager approved a goodwill payment on a complaint. How long until the money reaches the customer?
questions.note: Twin in the restating document's vocabulary (v1 tq12): the complaint path says money paid as goodwill 'follows the Refund Policy's payment processing (5 to 10 business days)'.

questions.query: What recovery time objective and recovery point objective apply to critical systems in a disaster?
questions.note: Twin: the Disaster Recovery Runbook restates the four-hour RTO; the Business Continuity Policy owns both targets (RTO 4 hours, RPO 30 minutes).

questions.query: After a customer's contract ends, how long do we keep their data, and how quickly is an earlier deletion request completed?
questions.note: Twin with two shared figures: the Privacy Policy restates 90 days and 30 days, and the DSAR process says 'The Data Retention Policy defines ... the 90-day post-contract retention'. Gold is the owner named by that pointer.

questions.query: After how many years of service can an employee take a sabbatical, and how long is it?
questions.note: Twin: the Employee Handbook restates the four-week sabbatical after seven years and says full details are in the Leave and Time Off Policy.

questions.query: Who has to approve a $6,000 corporate card purchase?
questions.note: Twin with two shared figures: the Corporate Card Policy says card expenses 'require approval under the same thresholds' and restates $2,500 and $10,000; the Employee Expense Policy owns the thresholds (VP from $2,500 to $10,000).

questions.query: How is customer support covered on public holidays?
questions.note: Twin: the On-Call Rotation says holiday coverage 'follows the Channel and Hours Policy's holiday rules'.

questions.query: A customer asks to speak to someone about how their case was handled. How quickly must we acknowledge it, and when does it move up to the next escalation level?
questions.note: Similar program (v1 tq05): the complaint path (ESC levels) says it is separate from the technical Incident Escalation Matrix (SEV levels). Four business hours, then ESC-2 after two business days.

questions.query: A customer who is unhappy with how support treated them has been escalated past the first level. How soon must the support manager call them?
questions.note: Similar program (v1 tq15): ESC-2 (call within one business day) versus the separate Incident Escalation Matrix SEV-2 (30-minute response).

questions.query: What are the response and resolution targets for a SEV-3 incident?
questions.note: Similar program: SEV-3 (4 hours, 72 hours) versus the complaint path's ESC-3, which the corpus keeps separate.

questions.query: How long does a Performance Improvement Plan last, and when are its progress reviews?
questions.note: Similar program: a PIP (60 days, reviews at day 30 and day 60) versus the onboarding guide's 30- or 60-day extension plans, which it keeps administratively distinct from performance management.

questions.query: From what amount does a contractor need a receipt for an expense claim?
questions.note: Similar program: contractor rules differ from the Employee Expense Policy; the receipt threshold is $50 instead of $25.

questions.query: How long do we keep prospect marketing data, and who can access security and audit logs?
questions.note: Similar policies: the Data Retention Policy says system logs are a different document with different periods. 24 months; the CISO's team, the CTO and engineering managers.

questions.query: How many customers can one employee refer per year under the referral program, and what minimum annual bookings must a reseller partner commit to?
questions.note: Similar programs the corpus calls separate (employee customer referrals versus partner deals). 10 per year; $50,000 after the first year.

questions.query: An employee is still medically unfit to work when their parental leave ends. What leave applies from then on?
questions.note: Similar programs: parental leave runs separately from sick leave; sick leave applies from that point under the Leave and Time Off Policy.
